blocksHtml:
• Description
  • Product Table
  • Video
  • Review

The Wi-Tek WI-AP719MP is a high-performance Wi-Fi 6 indoor mesh access point designed for offices, hotels, campuses, and enterprise wireless networks. With combined wireless speeds up to 1800Mbps, it delivers fast and stable connectivity for high-density environments.


This access point supports mesh networking, allowing multiple units to create seamless wireless coverage across large areas. It also features PoE input and PoE output ports, enabling the device to power other network equipment such as IP cameras or VoIP phones, simplifying installation and reducing cabling complexity.


Key Features


  • Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) technology for faster and more efficient wireless networking

  • Dual-Band speeds up to 1800Mbps

    • 574Mbps on 2.4GHz

    • 1201Mbps on 5GHz

  • Mesh networking support for wide-area wireless coverage
  • 3 Gigabit Ethernet ports (1 PoE Input + 2 PoE Output)
  • Fast roaming for seamless movement between access points
  • Cloud management support for remote configuration and monitoring
  • Advanced security features including WPA3 and VLAN support
